svg.aria-label: Zane: Full-stack engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, DevOps engineer, Tool builder. Nearly four years shipping web products for teams in Japan, Germany, Singapore and Sweden. The bronze drum's outer ring charts 369 contributions over the last year, one tick per week.
